summary: Saint Pete MRI, a St. Petersburg diagnostic imaging and sleep lab, identified unauthorized access on February 23, 2025. A third-party cybersecurity firm confirmed that scanned data may have been acquired by the unauthorized party, though electronic patient care systems were not compromised. On April 7, 2026, the facility confirmed exposed files contained names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, medical information, and health insurance information. Notification letters were mailed July 22, 2026, approximately 17 months after initial discovery; record count unclear.
